Triage: lands in `domain:devx` · `needs-user-decision`; rationale: area:package · Feature (images in in-app help manuals; `collect-docs` refuses every image today) · an outside builder delivering a client CRM whose acceptance asks for screenshots → p2. ADR-0046 §3.4 deliberately defers images to v2 (the platform asset service), so lifting that is a product choice for the maintainer, not a lane call: it goes to the decision box, not the queue.

Ruled: not planned · maintainer 2026-11-19T11:2xZ, verbatim: 「帮助手册 没必要放截图，否则仓库会爆炸吧」「而且已经在系统中，为什么还要看截图」

2026-11-19T11:25Z · **Closed as not planned on the maintainer's ruling.** In-app help manuals stay text-only, as ADR-0046 §3.4 has it: images would bloat package repositories, and a reader of an in-app manual is already looking at the system the steps describe. Write the steps against the live screens (field and button names) instead of screenshots.
